## Summary
Checkout threw a TypeError for about fifty minutes.

## Timeline
- 11:40 First TypeError on release web@2026.10.19-1 ([e1](https://sentry.example.test/organizations/example/issues/4821/events/e1/))
- 11:52 The same error repeated ([e2](https://sentry.example.test/organizations/example/issues/4821/events/e2/))
- 12:31 Seen once on web@2026.10.19-2 ([e3](https://sentry.example.test/organizations/example/issues/4821/events/e3/))

## Impact
Orders failed at checkout while the error was open; the events do not say how many.

## Causes
The events show the error began on web@2026.10.19-1; they do not show why.

## Follow-ups
- Add a test for an empty cart total.
- Find out why the error appeared once on web@2026.10.19-2.
